name: MCU Release Order Chart
description: An interactive MCU timeline from Iron Man to VisionQuest in release order, with spoiler-redacted connections between titles, a node-graph view of the whole web, phase and type filters, an MCU Adjacent switch (Fox X-Men, Spider-Men, Netflix shows), and watchlists for the big crossover films, including Disney+'s official Doomsday list. Filtered views are shareable by link.
